metadata.title: Suppression of cellular IL-1beta release
metadata.note: Raw author and database records are retained. Author CSV structure extraction is not an independent redraw of all structures. Exposure uncertainty is disclosed and is not replaced with guessed timing.

M001.context: Human THP-1 cells; LPS priming 3 h, compound pretreatment 40 min, then nigericin 40 min; secreted IL-1beta measured by ELISA; inhibition IC50.
M001.context_evidence: Author CSV IC50 column, source-specific ChEMBL CHEMBL5549264; fixed 2 uM inhibition column excluded.

raw_record.assay_context: Nigericin-induced IL-1beta release in THP-1; priming and timing pending

M002.context: Mouse bone-marrow-derived macrophages; LPS/ATP-triggered NLRP3 response; secreted IL-1beta measured by ELISA; inhibition IC50. The source database timing description is internally inconsistent and is not used to assign exact priming duration.
M002.context_evidence: Author CSV BMDM IL1beta IC50 column, ChEMBL CHEMBL6111980. Database says ATP priming then ATP trigger; no invented correction. Context remains distinct from THP-1/PBMC.
